entities.summary: Carlo Sciaccaluga is an Italian theatre director, actor and translator. He is the son of artists. He made his debut as an actor in 2009, performing in German with Matthias Langhoff at the Landestheater in Linz, Austria. He debuted as a director at a young age, staging an adaptation of Haruki Murakami's After the Quake.
